questions.question: Who did God call by name and fill with His Spirit to make the tabernacle and its furnishings?
God called the Sabbath a sign between Him and the Israelites. What did He want them to know through it?

answers.text: He is the LORD who makes them holy
He is the LORD who feeds them
He is the LORD who guides them

questions.question: God told Moses that anyone who did work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death. True or false?
Why did God say the Sabbath is a sign between Him and the Israelites forever?

answers.text: The LORD made the heavens and the earth in six days and rested on the seventh
The LORD led Israel out of Egypt in six days and rested on the seventh
The LORD gave all of His laws in six days and rested on the seventh
